package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type learningWorkspaceReaderStub struct {
	source domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource
	err    error
	calls  int
}

func (stub *learningWorkspaceReaderStub) ReadLearningWorkspace(_ context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource, error) {
	stub.calls++
	stub.source.StudentID = studentID
	return stub.source, stub.err
}

func TestGetLearningWorkspaceDisabledBeforeReader(t *testing.T) {
	reader := &learningWorkspaceReaderStub{}
	_, err := (GetLearningWorkspace{Reader: reader}).Handle(context.Background(), journeyStudentID)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrFeatureDisabled) || reader.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("disabled err=%v calls=%d", err, reader.calls)
	}
}

func TestGetLearningWorkspaceValidatesStudentAndBuildsBoundedProjection(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 12, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	reader := &learningWorkspaceReaderStub{source: domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{
		Context:      domain.StudentLearningContext{Schema: domain.LearningContextSchemaVersion, StudentID: journeyStudentID, SelectedLearningPathID: journeyPathID, Version: 2, UpdatedAt: &now},
		SelectedPath: &domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: journeyPathID, StudentID: journeyStudentID, CourseID: journeyCourseID, GoalCode: "learn_programming", CurriculumRevision: "r1", PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial", ReasonSummary: "Initial", Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: journeyLessonID, Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_gap"}}},
	}}
	useCase := GetLearningWorkspace{Reader: reader, Enabled: true}
	if _, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), "not-a-uuid"); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) || reader.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("invalid student err=%v calls=%d", err, reader.calls)
	}
	result, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), journeyStudentID)
	if err != nil || reader.calls != 1 || result.SelectedPath == nil || result.SelectedPath.LearningPathID != journeyPathID {
		t.Fatalf("workspace=%#v err=%v calls=%d", result, err, reader.calls)
	}
}

func TestGetLearningWorkspaceRejectsForeignRepositoryPath(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 12, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	reader := &learningWorkspaceReaderStub{source: domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{
		Context:      domain.StudentLearningContext{Schema: domain.LearningContextSchemaVersion, StudentID: journeyStudentID, SelectedLearningPathID: journeyPathID, Version: 1, UpdatedAt: &now},
		SelectedPath: &domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: journeyPathID, StudentID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", CourseID: journeyCourseID, GoalCode: "learn_programming", CurriculumRevision: "r1", PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial", ReasonSummary: "Initial", Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: journeyLessonID, Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_gap"}}},
	}}
	_, err := (GetLearningWorkspace{Reader: reader, Enabled: true}).Handle(context.Background(), journeyStudentID)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) || reader.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("foreign path err=%v calls=%d", err, reader.calls)
	}
}
